scenarios.derivation: AC 'API logs show headers; double click posts once; invoice run opens spool viewer when spool exists' with contracts 4.5/4.8 (one Idempotency-Key per instruction), frmStockMovement.vb:80-103 and frmSalesInvoiceRun.vb:45-69 (opens frmSpoolViewer 'Spool - <file>'); API log content is not observable through the DSL, so that clause is unknown. After F10 the legacy page opens the spool viewer itself when the run produced a spool file (frmSalesInvoiceRun.vb:59-62 OpenSpool, :66-70 main.OpenForm("frmSpoolViewer")), and the new viewer window is the active window on top of the run window, so no further click is part of the flow. [A07-AMEND agent-07-20261021T211031Z-a544e35d RG-101: re-run after exact labels: the spool viewer opens on F10; the extra toolbar click is not legacy] The posted message 'Movement <id> posted; balance now <qty>.' is written, the quantity box is cleared and the second F10 then finds no quantity and writes 'An item code and a quantity are required.' with cue !  WARNING (frmStockMovement.vb:80-103), so the posted text is asserted among the texts the page showed and the final status is the local warning (no second posting). [A07-AMEND agent-07-20261021T211031Z-a544e35d RG-106: the second F10 overwrites the posted message with the empty-quantity warning]
